name: Gambling Shop
description: Requires 3 GMTB to function. Allows the player to gamble for rewards.

fields.name: Reward Weight 1
fields.description: Sets the weight of reward tier 1. The value contributes to the first cumulative threshold.

fields.name: Reward Weight 2
fields.description: Sets the weight of reward tier 2. The value is added to the first weight to determine the second cumulative threshold.

fields.name: Reward Weight 3
fields.description: Sets the weight of reward tier 3. The value is added to the first two weights to determine the third cumulative threshold.

fields.name: Playable Rounds
fields.description: The number of times the player can play the gambling game.

fields.name: Cost
fields.description: Determines the cost to play the gambling game.
